After recent successes even AW writer Martin Duff was tipping Belgrave as 'dark horses' – and that's just how we saw ourselves as late as the Thursday night before the race.

News hound Martin Duff picked up on this in his AW report — but isn't having sound wind and fitness all part of the race? Our boys were cock-a-hoop and as our President rounded them up for a team photo' we now contemplated the fact that we have another six men barred from the race.

…Hare & Hounds but with Phil comfortably leading the field for his first ever Surrey League win (confounding AW reporter Martin Duff’s predictions) and beating two very tough Thames men in McFarlane and Sly, we had enough to keep us happy.…

By now aware of what the East London club had to come, most supporters had switched to backing the Beagles for the win (AW correspondent Martin Duff still persisted with the thought that it would be Leeds) but we pulled back half a minute on both of them thanks to Darren.

Not bad methinks for “a club in decline”, as our chief taunter Martin Duff wrote in AW of late. I can’t remember seeing such fine packing by our boys in the early stages – I just wish I’d had the ability to join the party.

“A classic race,” AW correspondent Martin Duff exclaimed. Indeed it was; and all credit to Huw Lobb who had done everything in his power but nevertheless had to accept a fourth defeat from Phil this winter.
